name: Ring of Shadows
body:
Aura faint transmutation ; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 20,500 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This blackened iron ring grants the wearer darkvision out to 60′ and a +5 competence bonus to Stealth checks. The wearer also gains the ability to cast darkness 3/day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells darkness, darkvision, Stealth 5 ranks; Cost 10,250 gp

Identification DC 20
